subject.title: feat(cursor): add token cost report with Cursor-metered total

question: Should Cursor detailed usage-event history require an explicit opt-in, or may the existing enabled-provider and cost-summary settings authorize that authenticated account-wide collection?
rationale: Source review can validate credential routing and account isolation, but only the repository owner can define whether an existing Cursor session implicitly authorizes collection of detailed remote history.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in first
options.body: Keep status and summary behavior unchanged by default and add a dedicated consent surface before fetching detailed Cursor usage events.

options.title: Approve existing settings
options.body: Treat the existing enabled-provider and cost-summary settings as sufficient authorization for detailed dashboard history collection.

options.title: Keep Cursor summary-only
options.body: Decline the private detailed-history integration and retain the current Cursor status and summary boundary.

recommendation.title: Require explicit opt-in first
recommendation.body: Keep status and summary behavior unchanged by default and add a dedicated consent surface before fetching detailed Cursor usage events.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the explicit product/privacy hold and has the strongest current-main history for Cursor authentication and session behavior.
